# bytepack-studio

> Pack text, JSON, SVG, and tiny media into size-safe Solana v1 inscription envelopes.

bytepack-studio is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/bytepack-studio/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference

- [Working features](https://github.com/nirholas/bytepack-studio/blob/HEAD/README.md#working-features)
- [Status](https://github.com/nirholas/bytepack-studio/blob/HEAD/README.md#status)
- [Run](https://github.com/nirholas/bytepack-studio/blob/HEAD/README.md#run)

- [License](https://github.com/nirholas/bytepack-studio/blob/HEAD/README.md#license)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/bytepack-studio/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
